12:   const drones = [];
13:   let gameOver = false;
14: 
15:   // input handling
16:   const keys = {};

18:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));

22:     let x, y, vx, vy;
23:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
24:     if (side === 0) { // left
25:       x = -20; y = Math.random() * H; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
26:     } else if (side === 1) { // right
27:       x = W + 20; y = Math.random() * H; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
28:     } else if (side === 2) { // top
29:       x = Math.random() * W; y = -20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed;
30:     } else { // bottom

33:     drones.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 10 });
